questions: Is a route the same both ways? For example, does Madina to Circle cost the same as Circle to Madina, or should each direction be added separately?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, with passengers only able to look up fares? If so, how should staff sign in?
If a passenger asks for two stops with no direct route between them, should the system just say there is no route, or work out a trip that changes trotros on the way and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
